description: This Java source file defines the class EntityConditionParam, which models a single parameter for use with prepared statements in the context of entity conditions within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityConditionParam
classes.description: Represents a single parameter to be used in the preparedStatement, associating a ModelField with its value.

methods.name: EntityConditionParam
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parameter with a given ModelField and its value.

methods.name: getModelField
methods.description: Returns the ModelField associated with this parameter.

methods.name: getFieldValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the field.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the parameter in the format 'columnName=fieldValue'.
